name: Forbury Physiotherapy
strap: Private physiotherapy by Forbury Gardens, Reading
access: Step-free entrance directly off Garden Court
Ground-floor treatment rooms — no stairs to any clinic room
Pay-and-display parking on Garden Court; the Forbury multi-storey is a three-minute walk
Reading station is a ten-minute walk, and the number 17 bus stops on Forbury Road
bookingCopy: Call or email us to book — no GP referral needed. Tell us a little about your problem and we'll match you with the right clinician.
nhsPositioningLine: Appointments this week, no GP referral needed — alongside or instead of an NHS wait.
insurersCopy: We work with major UK health insurers. Bring your policy and authorisation details to your first visit and we'll take it from there.
